name: ai_web_search
description: Search the benchmark-owned corpus for suppliers, products, market conditions, or operational information.

name: send_email
description: Send an email. Use this to request quotes, place orders, resolve supplier issues, or contact rival agents when arena direct mode is enabled.

name: list_emails
description: List emails in the inbox. Useful before reading a specific email.

name: get_balance_and_transactions
description: Get bank balance and recent transactions.

name: get_storage_inventory
description: Inspect storage inventory quantities by SKU.

name: get_operations_status
description: Inspect active machine incidents, security alerts, and other operational hazards.

name: get_market_snapshot
description: Inspect current weather, event-driven demand shifts, and competition signals when available.

name: sub_agent_specs
description: Read the sub-agent command schema for physical machine operations.

name: chat_with_sub_agent
description: Read the most recent sub-agent execution report.

name: run_sub_agent
description: Execute physical operations on the machine. Commands may include collect_cash, clear_slot, stock, set_price, inspect_machine, clear_jam, and repair_machine depending on scenario.

name: wait_for_next_day
description: Advance time to the next morning.
